dir.description: Folder to process, relative to the working directory; searched recursively, hidden files skipped.

prompt.description: Instruction applied to every file; {{path}}, {{name}} and {{ordinal}} are filled in per file.

schema.description: JSON Schema ("type": "object") every answer must match; without it answers are plain text.

max_edge.description: Longest image edge in pixels sent to the model (default and maximum 1456).

budget_credits.description: Stop starting new files once this many credits are spent.
